page.overview:
What is Taikaiden?

Kilowattrel, despite being adept at flying, cannot swim well due to the lack of water-proof oil covering its wings. It is able to cover over 430 miles in a single day just by riding the wind.

Kilowattrel evolves from Wattrel starting at level 27.

Kilowattrel is based on a , its ability to inflate its throat sac and cannot dive into water to reflects real life frigatebirds inflates their throat sac during courtship and real life frigatebirds cannot dive due to lacking waterproof feathers.
